concept: S3 bucket policy: aws:SecureTransport to enforce TLS
tests: How to make S3 reject requests without TLS.
expected: Bucket policy with Deny when aws:SecureTransport = false. Triggers: "encrypted in transit", "reject any request not using TLS".
why_not: Default encryption is at rest, not in transit; Versioning is unrelated; a VPC endpoint doesn't enforce TLS.
